page_title: UDI 1-2 LAZ | Udinese v Lazio 07/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Juan Luca Sacchi is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+3' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) takes the corner with a short pass.
90+1' Nehuen Perez (Udinese) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Juan Luca Sacchi had an easy-decision to make.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Florian Thauvin whips the ball in and it arrives at the feet of Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese), whose wild shot goes way over the crossbar.
88' Martin Payero (Udinese) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly low towards the middle of the goal, but Ivan Provedel is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
87' Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Mario Gila.
86' Wasted effort! Keinan Davis (Udinese) finds himself some space, looks up but sends a dreadful shot high over the bar from long range.
86' Martin Payero (Udinese) takes the free kick from the edge of the box, but the goalkeeper perfectly sets up the defensive wall and his effort is thwarted.
85' Referee Juan Luca Sacchi sees the trip by Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Udinese are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
83' Gabriele Cioffi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Keinan Davis (Udinese) replacing Sandi Lovric.
83' Here comes a substitution. Florian Thauvin (Udinese) is brought on as a substitute for Thomas Kristensen.
80' Felipe Anderson (Lazio) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it just wide of the right post.
76' 1 - 2 GOAL! A cross into the box is headed down by Felipe Anderson and Matias Vecino (Lazio) does brilliantly to get to the ball and fire home. 1:2.
75' Gabriele Cioffi prepares a substitution. Festy Ebosele is replaced by Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese).
73' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
71' A shot from the edge of the box by Isaac Success (Udinese) is a waste and goes well wide of the right post.
68' Substitution. Mattia Zaccagni makes his way off the pitch and Pedro (Lazio) comes on as his replacement.
68' Maurizio Sarri decides to make a substitution. Luca Pellegrini will be replaced by Manuel Lazzari (Lazio).
67' We are about to witness a subsitution. Isaac Success (Udinese) for Lorenzo Lucca.
65' Maduka Okoye leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Nicolo Rovella (Lazio).
62' Matias Vecino (Lazio) looks furious with himself after spurning a great chance. He pounces on the rebound around the penalty spot and drags a shot well wide of the right post.
61' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
59' 1 - 1 A cross from the free kick is whipped deep into the box by Sandi Lovric and Walace (Udinese) gets in a shot, sending the ball into the bottom left corner. 1:1.
58' Juan Luca Sacchi shows a yellow card to Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) for his blatant foul.

55' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear. Martin Payero (Udinese) tries his luck with a long-range shot from a rebound, but it isn't precise at all and the ball flies miles over the crossbar. Very poor shot.

55' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Udinese, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
53' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

53' Adam Marusic (Lazio) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Lazio.
51' The resulting set piece from Udinese is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
51' Roberto Pereyra (Udinese) strikes a powerful volley towards goal, but one of the defenders blocks his attempt.
49' Adam Marusic (Lazio) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
47' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the right post only for Ivan Provedel to dive and make a save.
46' Mario Gila (Lazio) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
46' Gabriele Cioffi has made a change at the break. Hassane Kamara has come on in place of Adam Masina (Udinese).
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Daichi Kamada (Lazio) comes off for Matias Vecino.
46' Maurizio Sarri makes a switch. Felipe Anderson is coming on in place of Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) at the start of the second period.
46' The whistle blows and Juan Luca Sacchi starts the second half.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+4' Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle and it's Walace (Udinese) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
45+2' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
45+1' Roberto Pereyra (Udinese) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Udinese get a corner.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
44' Joao Ferreira (Udinese) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
44' Nehuen Perez (Udinese) sends a long ball in, but Ivan Provedel comfortably gathers the ball.
42' The corner is swung in but Udinese can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
41' Festy Ebosele (Udinese) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. Udinese have been awarded a corner kick.
40' Daichi Kamada (Lazio) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Juan Luca Sacchi had an easy-decision to make.
38' It must be a yellow card. It is. Adam Masina (Udinese) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
35' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
35' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
35' Martin Payero (Udinese) has tested the patience of referee Juan Luca Sacchi and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
33' Lazio are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
27' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
26' Joao Ferreira (Udinese) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Ivan Provedel, who smothers the ball.
26' Total attempts – 2:2. The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 0:1.
22' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the free kick from Walace (Udinese) on the edge of the box.
22' Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle for a foul after Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) hacks down one of his opponents. Udinese earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
22' Roberto Pereyra (Udinese) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Ivan Provedel intercepts the ball.
20' Handball by Festy Ebosele (Udinese).

18' Maduka Okoye doesn't have to worry about that one. Taty Castellanos puts a cross in towards Daichi Kamada (Lazio), who is unable to keep his header on target from the centre of the box. He sends the ball high over the crossbar.
16' Festy Ebosele (Udinese) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Sandi Lovric. It's a throw-in for Lazio.
12' 0 - 1 Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) scores from the free kick with a daisy-cutter that goes under the jumping wall and into the bottom left corner. What a cheeky free kick that is!
11' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
10' Lazio are about to take a free kick from a very dangerous position.
10' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Thomas Kristensen (Udinese) was quite harsh and Juan Luca Sacchi didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
9' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
9' Lazio take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
5' None of the Udinese players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.

4' This shall not pass! Martin Payero (Udinese) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play and Udinese manage to earn a corner.
2' The game is interrupted now, Patric (Lazio) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Udinese will take the kick-off.
Juan Luca Sacchi was nominated as the referee for this game.
